oneTimeCosts.estimateMethod: official base application charge stated by the Department of Home Affairs, effective 1 July 2026
oneTimeCosts.label: Student visa (subclass 500) base application charge — primary applicant
oneTimeCosts.limitations: Base charge for the primary applicant. The official page says the charge starts at AUD 2,500 from 1 July 2026; lower charges apply to eligible groups and additional applicants may incur separate fees. Use the official Visa Pricing Estimator for the actual case; this is not a universal final fee.
oneTimeCosts.sourceTitle: Australian Department of Home Affairs — Student visa (subclass 500)

visaRequirement.note: Regulatory minimum, NOT a typical-cost estimate. The current Home Affairs Student visa page states AUD 29,710 for 12 months of the primary student applicant’s living costs, with separate amounts for accompanying family members. Tuition fees and travel are additional. Requirements and application circumstances can change; verify the official page before applying. Meeting this financial amount does not guarantee visa approval.
visaRequirement.sourceTitle: Australian Department of Home Affairs — Subclass 500 Student visa (official current requirements)
